title: ARR-1 proof bundle
description: Everything a third party needs to verify one receipt without contacting the issuer again.

receipt.description: The receipt core (see receipt-core.schema.json) plus its fingerprint.

status.description: verified: delivered and anchored. recorded: delivered, not yet anchored. failed: paid, not delivered.

position.description: Where the sibling goes when the pair is hashed.

path.description: Sibling hashes from the leaf up to the root, nearest first.

merkle.description: Which tree rule folds this path. rfc9162: leaf = sha256(0x00 ‖ fingerprint), node = sha256(0x01 ‖ left ‖ right). arr1-v1: the ARR-1 1.0 rule, no prefixes, odd node paired with itself.

leafIndex.description: Position of this receipt in the account's log (rfc9162) or in the batch (arr1-v1).

treeSize.description: How many leaves the tree whose root is stated held.

message.description: Public URL where the anchor record can be read from the ledger, without the issuer.

root.description: Where in the ledger message the root is found: metadata.root.rootHashB64u for HCS-27 checkpoints, root for ARR-1 1.0 records.

consistency.description: Optional. Proof that an earlier published root is contained unchanged in this one (RFC 9162 §2.1.4).

to.description: The later tree size, the one whose root is stated.
